sahaayak.welcomeGreeting: Hello! I can help you use this platform.
sahaayak.welcomePrompt: Type help to see available commands.
sahaayak.inputPlaceholder: Type a command (e.g. help, register, login) or speak...
sahaayak.medicalWarningMessage: Sahaayak is a platform navigation assistant and cannot provide medical advice, diagnose illnesses, or interpret clinical symptoms/records. For medical care, please consult a healthcare professional at your nearest PHC/CHC or call the Kerala DISHA 24x7 Helpline at 1056.
sahaayak.unknownCommand: Command not recognized: "{cmd}". Type 'help' to see all valid navigation and account commands.
sahaayak.cmdHelpDesc: Available commands: login, register, health-id, qr, records, language, profile, password, contact, clear.
sahaayak.cmdLoginDesc: Healthcare workers, PHC doctors, and camp volunteers can sign in to manage clinical entries, update screenings, and access the surveillance dashboard.
sahaayak.cmdRegisterDesc: Enroll a new guest worker into the Kerala Athidhi Health Registry with basic demographic details and generate an instant portable health ID.
sahaayak.cmdHealthIdDesc: Every registered worker receives a unique health ID (e.g., KL-MH-829104). This ID allows seamless record portability across all 14 Kerala districts without losing medical history.
sahaayak.cmdQrTitle: QR Smart Code on Health Passport
sahaayak.cmdQrDesc: The Health Passport displays a scannable QR code containing the worker's verified portable health ID. Clinicians can scan it at mobile camps to instantly pull up history.
sahaayak.cmdRecordsDesc: Review past clinical consultations, diagnostic screenings (blood sugar, BP, sputum AFB), and prescribed treatments recorded at PHCs and Taluk hospitals.
sahaayak.cmdLanguageDesc: MigrantHealth supports 5 languages: English, Malayalam (മലയാളം), Hindi (हिन्दी), Bengali (বাংলা), and Odia (ଓଡ଼ିଆ). Use the language selector in the top bar to switch anytime.
sahaayak.cmdProfileDesc: Search any enrolled worker by name or portable ID in the Registry to view their unified clinical timeline, risk status badge, and treatment regimens.
sahaayak.cmdPasswordDesc: For demo access, you can sign in with staff@kerala.gov.in / password123. To reset production credentials, contact your District Health Officer.
sahaayak.cmdContactDesc: Need assistance? Call Kerala DISHA 24x7 Health Helpline at 1056 or toll-free at 1800-425-1425. You can also visit your nearest Labour Facilitation Centre.

healthCheck.title: 2-Minute Rapid Health & Triage Screening

healthCheck.fitForWorkAlert: Stable & Fit for Duty: No urgent red flags detected. Routine camp wellness checks recommended.

voiceInput.title: Speak Your Health History
voiceInput.subtitle: Voice-enabled clinical speech-to-text in Malayalam, Hindi, Bengali, Odia & English
voiceInput.listening: Listening... Speak your symptoms clearly now
voiceInput.placeholder: Transcribed voice symptoms will appear here in real-time...

privacyPage.mainSubtitle: Your health information belongs exclusively to you. Encrypted, accessible only with your consent, and strictly protected under Kerala public health law.
privacyPage.trustBadgeDesc: DPDP Protected • Never Shared with Employers
privacyPage.pillar1Desc: All diagnostic reports, prescriptions, and identity details are encrypted with government-grade AES-256 security. No unauthorized entity can intercept or alter your records.
privacyPage.pillar2Title: Only You & Authorized Doctors with Consent
privacyPage.pillar2Desc: Access is granted only when you share your Portable Health ID or show your QR code to a licensed doctor or healthcare staff at Kerala PHCs, CHCs, or mobile medical units.
privacyPage.pillar3Title: NEVER Shared with Employers or Landlords
privacyPage.pillar3Desc: Your health status, sickness records, and diagnoses are strictly confidential. They are never shared with contractors, factory owners, mill supervisors, or landlords.
privacyPage.consentManagerSubtitle: View and control which health facilities currently have permission to access your digital records
privacyPage.accessLogDesc: Full transparency: Every clinical record lookup by a doctor or staff member is logged with timestamp and facility ID.
privacyPage.exportDataDesc: Under the DPDP Act, you have the right to download a complete verified copy of your Athidhi Swasthya Passport anytime.

schemesPage.mainSubtitle: Universal social security, insurance coverage, and medical assistance matched specifically to your guest worker profile.
schemesPage.eligibleAlertsTitle: You May Be Eligible For These Benefits
schemesPage.eligibleAlertsDesc: Matched against your age, home state, occupational sector, and health triage risk status.
schemesPage.allSchemesSubtitle: Browse the complete repository of central and state health protection programs.
